Facts relevant for the disposal of this appeal are that the respondent No. 1 instituted Money Suit No. 16 of 1998 against the appellant and others in the Court of Subordinate Judge, Chittagong for realization of Tk. 842250.60 with interest. The appellant as defendant contested the suit by filing written statement. The learned Subordinate Judge by his judgment and order dated 24.06.2004 decreed the suit with interest as prayed for. Being aggrieved by the said judgment and decree the appellant preferred the appeal in the High Court Division. 

 (a) the court from whose decree the appeal is preferred has refused to admit evidence which ought to have been admitted or
